    (COUNT(CASE WHEN z1.borough = 'Manhattan' THEN 1 END.0) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM trips t
JOIN zones z1 ON t.pu_location_id = z1.location_id
JOIN zones z2 ON t.do_location_id = z2.location_id
WHERE z2.zone = 'LaGuardia Airport';

raw:
SELECT 
    strftime('%W', t.pickup_datetime) AS week_day,
    AVG(t.trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance
FROM trips t
GROUP BY week_day
ORDER BY avg_trip_distance DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SUM(t.fare_amount) / SUM(t.trip_distance) AS fare_per_mile

raw:
SELECT z.zone, SUM(t.tip_amount) AS total_tips
FROM trips t
JOIN zones z ON t.pu_location_id = z.location_id
WHERE z.borough = 'Brooklyn'
GROUP BY z.zone
ORDER BY total_tips DESC
LIMIT 3;

raw:

    (COUNT(CASE 
        WHEN z.zone IN ('JFK Airport', 'LaGuardia Airport', 'Newark Airport') THEN 1 
    END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM trips t

WHERE t.trip_distance > 20;
